title: DAYBREAK
summary: A sunny packaging identity that turns three roast personalities into an approachable everyday shopping choice.
scope: AI-assisted campaign and catalog art direction

cover.alt: DAYBREAK blue, orange and butter coffee packaging on a blue plinth in morning light

integration.copyAssets: Copy assets/ contents recursively to dist/assets/; all names are daybreak-prefixed or scoped in daybreak/fonts.
integration.caseWrapping: case.html is one main fragment, already namespaced. Wrap in the existing portfolio document shell; do not nest main elements.
integration.demo: Copy demo.html to dist/daybreak-demo.html without rebuilding its bag.
integration.evidence: Internal review only; not deployment assets. No case/deployed HTML depends on evidence/.
integration.parentOwnership: Portfolio overview, cards, navigation, shared builder, actual store integration and publishing remain with coordinating chat.

baseSource: Local parent checkout, not remote GitHub

publicationStatus: Portfolio on Netlify; Shopify demo published. Historical module preview instructions below refer to the retained HTML prototype.
